cover_headline: Tata Steel Q2 Profit Rises 16.2% to Rs 3,699.59 Crore on India Strength
facts: Tata Steel's consolidated reported profit after tax for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 rose 16.2% year on year to Rs 3,699.59 crore
Consolidated EBITDA rose 17% year on year to Rs 10,665 crore, with India revenue of Rs 42,653 crore
Net debt stood at Rs 91,423 crore

end.headline: Tata Steel Q2 Profit Rises 16.2% to Rs 3,699.59 Crore on India Strength
end.line: India remained the strongest operating market, with India EBITDA of Rs 10,634 crore at a margin of 25%.
